hero.headline:
Understand your
well-being through
your own patterns
hero.sub: NOVA helps you reflect on your daily routine, discover recurring patterns, and receive gentle, responsible AI-powered insights — without ever replacing a professional.

howItWorks.title: Simple, consistent, meaningful
howItWorks.sub: Four steps that turn daily reflections into personal understanding.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Record how you feel, your sleep, energy and workload in under a minute.
howItWorks.step2Desc: NOVA looks for relationships in your history — not assumptions, just observations.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Deterministic comparisons turn your entries into understandable, honest observations.
howItWorks.step4Desc: Small, realistic changes for you to experiment with. You're always in control.

features.title:
Everything you need to
understand your routine
features.card1Desc: NOVA analyses your history to surface recurring relationships between your habits and reported well-being.
features.card2Desc: Plain-language observations from your own data — periods of lower energy, sleep relationships, consistency patterns.
features.card3Desc: When a pattern is found, NOVA suggests small, realistic experiments. You decide what to try.

privacy.title:
Your data is yours.
Always.
privacy.sub: Privacy isn't a feature added after the fact — it's how NOVA is built from the ground up.
privacy.point1Desc: Only information needed for the functionality is collected. Nothing more.
privacy.point2Desc: Patterns in your data are not medical conclusions. NOVA never claims otherwise.
privacy.point3Desc: AI suggestions are suggestions. You remain fully responsible for your own choices.
privacy.point4Desc: Each component of the system only has access to what it strictly needs.

ai.title:
AI with clear,
enforced boundaries
ai.sub: NOVA uses AI to identify patterns and generate supportive insights. It does not diagnose, prescribe, or replace qualified professionals.
ai.disclaimer: NOVA is not a medical or diagnostic system and does not replace qualified mental health professionals.

cta.title: Ready to understand yourself better?
cta.sub: Start your first check-in today — it takes less than a minute.

footer.tagline: A privacy-first mental wellness platform built around responsible AI.
footer.author: Author
footer.disclaimer: NOVA is not a medical or diagnostic system. It does not replace qualified mental health professionals.

checkin.title: Daily Check-in
checkin.sub: Take a moment to reflect on your day.
checkin.step1Sub: Select the emoji that best matches your current mood.
checkin.step2Sub: Slide to reflect on your day.
checkin.step3Sub: Optional: add a short note about your day.
checkin.notePlaceholder: e.g. Had a long meeting, felt distracted…
checkin.step4Sub: Here's a summary of your check-in.
checkin.successSub: Great work. We'll use this to build your personal picture.

insights.title: Your Insights
insights.sub: Patterns discovered from your check-in history.
insights.noData: Complete at least 5 check-ins to start seeing patterns.
insights.disclaimer: These observations are based on your personal data. They are not medical diagnoses.
